description: Saturating signed subtraction written with CERT-style overflow tests not folded to llvm.ssub.sat
notes: Found while screening C candidates. The overflow tests of the CERT C compliant solution for subtraction are used to saturate; written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps a branch, compares, selects and a phi: 14 IR instructions. expected.ll is llvm.ssub.sat.i32: 2 IR instructions. Different pattern from sadd-overflow-check-i32 (saturated result instead of an overflow flag). No LLVM issue found for this pattern. Gain estimated by llvm-mca (godbolt llc and llvm-mca trunk, -mcpu=skylake, cycles per 100 iterations): 485 vs 210. expected.ll proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 alive-tv, 2026-10-28: src = clang trunk -O3 IR of src.c (godbolt cclang_trunk, -O3 --target=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -march=skylake -emit-llvm -S -g0) renamed @src, tgt = expected.ll renamed @tgt, identical signature; output 'Transformation seems to be correct!' with no warning. Run on Alive2's own Compiler Explorer instance (alive2.llvm.org/ce, compiler id 'alive'), since godbolt.org does not host alive-tv.
